basic_info.description: This chic boutique with an exclusive 15 units loft condo, located in vibrant SOMA has so much to offer. This top-floor, two-level loft offers a stunning 1,199 sqft of stylish space. Boasting arched, soaring ceilings and dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows, this condo is bathed in warm natural light while enjoying exceptional privacy on the south side of the building.  Lower level offers a kitchen equipped with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a gas range, and a breakfast bar. The adjacent dining area shines with new LED canned lighting, leading to an open, bright living room. A versatile bedroom on this level doubles as a home office, workout space.   Upper Level:Retreat upstairs to a spacious en suite bedroom featuring ample storage, a full bathroom, and a work nook or vanity station.  Recently sanded & polished HWfloors,fresh interior paint throughout, In-unit laundry, Deeded parking for one car, and Exclusive access to a rooftop patio with views. Pet Friendly.   Moments from world-class dining, Salesforce, Amazon, UCSF, Metreon, WholeFoods, nightlife and easy access to Caltrain, BART, and Muni. Don't miss the chance to experience the best of SOMA living in this chic, private loft.
